tagline: Rotate the sculpture. Release every cube whose arrow path is clear. Expose the core.
canvasAria: 3D cube assembly. Use arrow keys to choose a cube and Enter to release it.

modeLearnBlurb: Interactive lessons — one rule at a time, by doing.
modeJourneyBlurb: Forty authored stages across five chapters.
modeDailyBlurb: One shared board per UTC day, ranked.
modePracticeBlurb: Selectable difficulty, restart and undo. Never ranked.
modeChallengeBlurb: Move limits, speed targets, altered layouts.
modeScoresBlurb: Your best scores per board, and the StarHermit high-score board when signed in.
diffBlurb_hard: A grand work with a core.

noEntries: No entries yet. Be the first.
scoresHosted: The global board is platform-owned and read-only. Records below are your personal bests on this device, synced to your account.
scoresOffline: Offline: boards are local and labeled casual. Connect through the host for the global board.
noGlobalBoard: No global board for this game yet — showing this device’s records.
helpGoalText: Every cube with an arrow wants to leave. A cube can leave only when its arrow path to the sky is clear. Release every cube to win; some boards hide a core to expose.
helpStonesText: Grey stones never move. Banded cubes are locked until their glowing key cube is released.
helpScoringText: Points for every release, a completion bonus, and efficiency bonuses for staying under par taps, rotations and time. Invalid taps cost points.
helpReadingText: Select or hover a cube to preview its path. The Board list button shows every cube, its direction and its state in text.
helpTouch: Touch: tap a cube to release it, drag on empty sky to rotate. Mouse: click and drag the same way.
profileHosted: Signed in as {name} — your account nickname (change it in your platform profile). Progress syncs to your account.
profileGuest: Guest profile stored on this device. Sign-in becomes available when hosted.

objectiveCore: Release every cube to expose the core.

chapterBlurbs.2: Stones never move. Route around them.
chapterBlurbs.3: Locked cubes open when their key is released.
chapterBlurbs.4: Sparse sculptures in a wider sky.
tips.j01: Tap a cube whose arrow points into open sky.
tips.j02: Drag or press Q/E to rotate the assembly and find clear paths.
tips.j08: Clear the board under par taps and rotations for three stars.
tips.j09: Grey stone cubes can never be released.
tips.j11: Expose the golden core by clearing everything around it.
tips.j17: A banded cube is locked. Release its glowing key cube first.
tips.j40: The grand work. Take it apart, cube by cube.
lessonGoals.t2: Learn why some cubes cannot leave yet.
lessonGoals.t3: Rotate the assembly to read every arrow.
lessonGoals.t5: Unlock banded cubes by releasing their key.
lessonGoals.t6: Score by finishing under par taps and rotations.
lessonSteps.t1.0: Each cube has an arrow. If its path to the sky is clear, tapping releases it. Release the highlighted cube.
lessonSteps.t1.1: The path ahead of the next cube is now open. Release it.
lessonSteps.t1.2: One more. Clear the board to finish the lesson.
lessonSteps.t2.0: The left cube points east, but another cube sits in its way. Try tapping it — the game will explain why it cannot move.
lessonSteps.t2.1: Blocked cubes become free once the cubes in front of them leave. Release the right cube first.
lessonSteps.t2.2: Now the path is clear. Finish the board.
lessonSteps.t3.0: Some arrows face away from you. Rotate the assembly: drag on empty sky, or press Q / E.
lessonSteps.t3.1: Better. Rotations are counted, and staying under par earns a star. Now clear the board in any order.
lessonSteps.t4.0: The grey cube is stone. It has no arrow and can never leave. Try it to see the explanation.
lessonSteps.t4.1: Every arrow here points past the stone into open sky. Clear the board.
lessonSteps.t5.0: The banded cube is locked. Try to release it.
lessonSteps.t5.1: Its key is the glowing cube. Release the key to open the lock.
lessonSteps.t5.2: Unlocked. Clear the board to finish.
lessonSteps.t6.0: Every board has pars for taps and rotations. Finishing under par earns stars and efficiency bonuses — wasted taps and spins cost them. Clear the board.
challengeBlurbs.ch-exact-1: No wasted taps. The move limit equals the cube count.
challengeBlurbs.ch-exact-2: A hollow work with a stone, and not one tap to spare.
challengeBlurbs.ch-speed-1: Clear the assembly before the sky dims.
challengeBlurbs.ch-speed-2: A larger work, a longer fuse.
challengeBlurbs.ch-sparse-1: A scattered altered layout — read the gaps.
challengeBlurbs.ch-core-1: Expose the core before time runs out.
challengeBlurbs.ch-grand-1: A deep hollow work with two taps of slack.
challengeBlurbs.ch-blind-1: No hints, no undo, and a strict count.
achievements.key-master.1: Complete 10 Journey stages that use locks.
achievements.daily-streak-3.1: Complete the Daily on 3 consecutive UTC days.
achievements.grand-work.1: Complete the final Journey stage, Final Light.
